description: This file declares the dmProviderDatabase class which manages provider information, queries, and related operations in the context of a data provider system, including methods to create queries and retrieve provider info by different identifiers.

classes.name: dmProviderDatabase
classes.description: A class that manages the provider database, offering methods for creating queries and retrieving provider information by various identifiers.

methods.name: dmProviderDatabase
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the database with a directory path.

methods.name: createQuery with operation and string
methods.description: Creates a dmQuery object based on a specific provider operation and string parameter.

methods.name: getProviderByProviderName
methods.description: Retrieves provider info by provider name.

methods.name: getProviderByModelName
methods.description: Retrieves provider info by model name.

methods.name: getProviderByPropertyName
methods.description: Retrieves provider info by property name, optionally indicating if it's a list item.

methods.name: getProviderByObjectName
methods.description: Retrieves provider info by object name, optionally indicating if it's a list item.
